INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Application Areas of ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Application Areas of ICT.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Application Areas of ICT.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Application Areas of ICT.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Application Areas of ICT.

2. When learning Word Processing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Word Processing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Word Processing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Word Processing.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.

5. When learning Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.

6. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.

7. When learning Presentation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Presentation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Presentation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Presentation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Presentation.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

9. When learning Introduction to ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

11. When learning Operating Systems and Utilities, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating Systems and Utilities.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating Systems and Utilities.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating Systems and Utilities.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Operating Systems and Utilities.

12. When learning Desktop Publishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing.

13. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

14. When learning Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

15. When learning Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
